blocks.passage:
Have you ever thought about the importance of listening to elders? In fact, children need to listen to them for several reasons. First, they are our first teachers who teach us how to love, how to care, how to forgive and how to accept. Second, elders have more knowledge and wisdom than their children. If children learn from their wisdom, their life quality will improve. Third, by facing many ups and downs in life, they have gained valuable experience that is worth respecting and learning from.
Another important point we can learn from the elders is about our heritage and culture. This helps us to be proud of our past. Knowing about our traditional beliefs and culture brings us a sense of belonging, identity of our past and the responsibility to protect them for our future generations. To add more, our parents have learned, created or have been brought up with a set of moral values and principles which have made them successful in life. Gaining knowledge of these factors can create a set of guidelines that are important for their children's life. In conclusion, the experience that elders have gained through years is a valuable treasure for next generation.

blocks.passage: Expanding vocabulary is necessary for communication and understanding. But what are some useful ways to achieve that? First, reading is a fantastic way to improve our vocabulary. This is possible by reading books, newspapers and checking the meaning of unfamiliar words in a dictionary. In this way, learners can understand the text better and remember the new words for future use. The second important technique to improve vocabulary is watching English movies. By doing this, learners can practice both listening and speaking skills. Third, they can write down unknown words they face for the first time in their notebook and look them up later. Lastly, to make learning vocabulary more effective, learners can use labeling as a strategy to name objects around their house. By writing the names of objects on small pieces of paper and sticking the notes to things such as a desk, window or fridge, learners can see words around them again and again. These are just some important ways to improve learners' vocabulary.

blocks.passage:
Sending emails, watching online videos and downloading music may seem harmless, but our online habits have a surprising impact on the environment. The impact of our online activities on the internet is called "Internet Pollution".
Recently, the Internet has become a large part of our lives. According to some estimates, more than five billion people were online in 2022 — that's more than 60 percent of world's population. This number continues to grow rapidly as more people go online every year. This means that a large amount of data is stored in computers everyday which requires connecting more and more devices to the Internet. This leads to processing a huge amount of data and powering a large number of devices which can cause serious challenges for the environment.
However, there are some ways to protect the environment against the Internet Pollution. Since people are not aware of the amount of energy they waste by their online habits, teaching them how to use the Internet wisely is helpful. Also, developing technologies that help reduce energy consumption of our devices is another way. This can be done by using clean energy sources. Google, for example, uses solar panels and wind farms to power its data centers.
